# fw_vfs MCP tool

> Interact with Fw SQLite CAS VFS OS (mounts, ls, read, write). Input schema, parameters and a tools/call example for the fw_vfs MCP tool.

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/mcp/fw-vfs/

Interact with Fw SQLite CAS VFS OS (mounts, ls, read, write).

## Call it

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "fw_vfs",
    "arguments": {
      "action": "mounts"
    }
  }
}
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | `string: mounts, ls, read, write` | yes |  |
| `path` | `string` | no |  |
| `content` | `string` | no |  |
